# PosCert ERP

PosCert is a cloud POS and business ERP platform for retail stores, multi-branch businesses, and electronics repair shops.

- [ERP Inventory](https://poscert.com/erp-inventory)

- [Technician Tools](https://poscert.com/technician-tools)
- [Pricing](https://poscert.com/pricing)
